children: U.S. President Donald Trump reported 1,156 securities transactions in July, with the trades carrying a combined value of roughly $79M to $270M, according to his latest financial disclosure. Purchases totaled at least $43.6M, while sales amounted to at least $35.6M.
The largest transactions were July 20 sales of Microsoft
and Amazon
, each valued between $5M and $25M. Three days later, the portfolio bought between $100,001 and $250,000 of Microsoft
and between $1,001 and $15,000 of Amazon
The July 20 activity also included a sale of Oracle
valued at $1M to $5M and a purchase of Nvidia
worth $500,001 to $1M.
The portfolio also bought $1M to $5M each of Intuit
, Marvell Technology
, Salesforce
and Church & Dwight
, as well as $250,001 to $500,000 of Axon Enterprise
Trump sold $250,001 to $500,000 of Northrop Grumman

on July 20, the same day he signed an executive order tightening supply-chain rules for defense contractors and restricting waivers for certain materials sourced from China and other covered countries.
The filing showed further trades involving Elon Musk-linked companies. Trump bought $15,001 to $50,000 of SpaceX
shares on July 10 and sold $1,001 to $15,000 a week later.
He also traded Tesla
in July, selling a combined $131,004 to $365,000 across four transactions before buying another $100,001 to $250,000 of Tesla
shares on July 27.
Looking at his trades in funds, on July 8, the portfolio bought $1M to $5M each of the State Street SPDR Bloomberg International Treasury Bond ETF
, Fidelity MSCI Communication Services Index ETF
, Vanguard Short-Term Bond Index Fund ETF
and Vanguard Dividend Appreciation Index Fund ETF
, while selling $1M to $5M each of the iShares U.S. Treasury Bond ETF
, State Street Communication Services Select Sector SPDR ETF
and iShares International Treasury Bond ETF
The
followed 1,051 transactions in June, valued at $78.1M to $263.1M.

title: Trump July disclosure: 1,156 trades, Microsoft and Amazon among largest sales
